about: A young woman from the 21st century with sharp swordsmanship skills finds herself in Honnō-ji during the Sengoku period! Together with a trio of newfound ninja friends, she races through the Underworld beneath Honnō-ji, confronted by enraged corpses at every turn!
summary: A young woman from the 21st century with sharp swordsmanship skills finds herself in Honnō-ji during the Sengoku period!
